title: 第8章 别玩太晚
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

办公室内，噼啪作响的键盘敲击声连绵不断，一条条建议次第出现在祖国人眼前的电子显示屏上。

屏幕文字清晰罗列着参考方案：顺从莱恩的想法，不要提前剧透。但您可以这样告诉他：

“儿子，这部影片取材于我的真实过往，只不过里面反派的战力被刻意渲染夸大了一点，我可是祖国人，这个世界最强大的超级英雄，绝不会落到那种狼狈不堪的境地。”

对话内容结束，特别工作小组还贴心地给了祖国人此段对话的理由。

应持续侧重凸显自身绝对强悍的实力，借此筑牢莱恩的心理依赖，让莱恩真切感受到来自父亲（也就是您，祖国人）所带来的安全感。

阿祖的目光在电子屏幕上一扫而过。

经年累月锻炼出来的公关形象，让他的语气立即变得极为符合这段对话的口吻，并且还在其中带上了充沛的情感。

“儿子，这部影片取材于……”

“可是父亲……”

停顿片刻，莱恩才接着问出他精心准备的问题：“这个世界真的没有人能够给你带来麻烦吗？”

“如果一个人那么强大，谁都无法伤害到他，那其他人不会害怕他吗？”

“爸爸，其他人会害怕你吗？”

电话中莱恩的话才落地，一旁微笑站立的艾什莉就猛地攥紧了文件夹，白毛汗瞬间湿透衣衫。

办公室里一时间落针可闻，安静极了。

阿祖的目光缓缓从一个又一个人的身体上划过，超级视力赋予他看穿人体的可怕视觉，他清晰地看到，这间屋子里的所有人的心脏，全都如鼓擂、如浪涌。

沉寂几秒后，阿祖才挥了挥手，人们如蒙大赦般姿态狼狈地逃离现场。

等人都离开后，阿祖才带着几分茫然的低语：“害怕……”

他低声呢喃着这两个字，眼底也闪过一丝不易察觉的落寞。

向来所向披靡、自认凌驾万物的他从未认真想过这个问题，直到玛德琳被他杀死。

他思考过，可却想不明白为什么。

“我生来强大，无人能敌，世人本该爱戴我、尊崇我，我一直以为，这就是强者该有的模样。”

祖国人的语气里有着一丝不肯认输的执拗。

可话锋转瞬便又软了下来，只剩下身为父亲的柔软：“我…从来都不是为了让人畏惧我才选择成为一个英雄，莱恩……”

他微微垂眸，声音更轻了几分，带着一丝小心翼翼的试探：“在你心里……爸爸会让你感到害怕吗？”

“当然不会了，你是这个世上最好的爸爸！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

In the office, the crackling keyboard sounds continued, and suggestions appeared one after another on the electronic display in front of the people of the motherland.

The text on the screen clearly lists the reference plan: follow Ryan’s ideas and don’t spoil it in advance.But you can tell him this:

"Son, this film is based on my real past, but the villain's combat power is deliberately exaggerated. I am a native of my motherland, the most powerful superhero in the world, and I will never fall into that embarrassing situation."

At the end of the dialogue, the special working group thoughtfully gave the people of the motherland a reason for this dialogue.

We should continue to focus on highlighting our absolute strength, so as to build up Ryan's psychological dependence and let Ryan truly feel the sense of security brought by his father (that is, you, the motherland).

Azu's eyes swept across the electronic screen.

His public relations image, which he has honed over many years, made his tone immediately fit the tone of this conversation, and also brought a lot of emotion to it.

"Son, this film is based on..."

"But father..."

After a moment of pause, Ryan then asked his carefully prepared question: "Is it true that no one in this world can cause you trouble?"

"If a person is so powerful that no one can hurt him, wouldn't others be afraid of him?"

"Dad, are other people afraid of you?"

As soon as Ryan finished talking on the phone, Ashley, who was standing with a smile on her side, clenched the folder tightly, and her clothes were soaked with white hair and sweat.

You could hear a needle drop in the office for a while, and it was extremely quiet.

Azu's eyes slowly passed over the bodies of one person after another. His super vision gave him the terrifying vision of seeing through the human body. He could clearly see that the hearts of everyone in this room were beating like drums and surging like waves.

After a few seconds of silence, Azu waved his hand, and people fled the scene in embarrassment as if they had been granted amnesty.

After everyone left, Azu whispered in a dazed tone: "Afraid..."

He murmured these two words in a low voice, and an imperceptible loneliness flashed in his eyes.

He, who has always been invincible and considered himself superior to all things, never seriously thought about this issue until Madeleine was killed by him.

He thought about it, but couldn't figure out why.

"I was born strong and invincible. People in the world should love and respect me. I always thought that this is what a strong person should look like."

There is a hint of stubbornness in the tone of the motherland that refuses to admit defeat.

But the conversation softened again in a flash, leaving only the softness of a father: "I... never chose to be a hero just to be feared, Ryan..."

He lowered his eyes slightly, and his voice was a little softer, with a hint of cautious testing: "In your heart...does daddy make you afraid?"

"Of course not, you are the best dad in the world!"
